text:
lena: Heads-up: small doc fixes (typos, broken links, one-line SDK snippet updates) are piling up. Can we create a "fast-approve" lane so these don't sit for days?
marc: +1. Our normal review queue is busy with bigger migration PRs. A lightweight lane makes sense but we need clear guardrails.
rachel: what if we require: 1) changed files only under `/docs` or `/site`, 2) no changes to `examples/` or `pkg/`, 3) linkcheck + lint green, 4) single-line or single-file change?
jorge: also enforce that any code block edits are non-executable (e.g., markdown formatting) — otherwise request regular code review.
lena: good call. can we add a label `docs-fast-approve` and a tiny checklist in the PR template?
marc: propose weekly on-call reviewer from docs team who can merge these within same business day. they should scan the PR, confirm checklist, hit merge. rotate on Monday mornings.
rachel: operational detail: preview builds sometimes fail for infra reasons. docs-ci-bot, if preview fails with "image pull timeout" or similar, can you auto-retry once and add a comment linking the retry?
docs-ci-bot: noted. preview retry automation enabled for infra timeouts. will post: "Preview retried due to infra timeout (1/1)."
jorge: sample PR template fragment:```
- docs-only: [ ] (changes limited to `/docs` or `/site`)
- single-file: [ ] (one markdown file or trivial metadata)
- linkcheck: [ ] (linkcheck CI passed)
- lint: [ ] (spellcheck/lint passed)
- preview: [ ] (preview succeeded OR retried due to infra timeout)
- fast-approver: @<weekly-oncall>
```
lena: nice. who volunteers for the first rotation? I'll take the remainder of this week for quick merges.
marc: I'll do next week. I'll also add a small GitHub Action that flags PRs matching the docs-only pattern and suggests the label (doesn't auto-apply).
rachel: let's run the trial for 3 weeks and measure median time-to-merge for docs-only PRs. If it drops under 8 hours we're golden.
jorge: one more: include a sentinel check in the action that refuses to label if any file in `examples/` or `src/` changed. simple path scan.
lena: action items: marc -> create action + label; jorge -> update PR template snippet; docs-ci-bot -> ensure single retry on infra pull timeouts; rachel -> track metrics; lena -> on-call this partial week.
marc: opening PR for the GH Action today. will ping once it's up.
rachel: thanks all. should cut down the tiny fix backlog fast. :smile:
lena: thanks team. check-in after week 1 to tweak if needed.
__note: Single Slack thread string with messages in chronological order, per agents.md formatting rules.
